name: Sarah S Latef
headline: Turn Telia’s usage data into subscriptions that stay.
saw: Most operators in your market sell mobile, broadband and TV bundles through a homepage that shows every visitor the same offer, whether they are a new household or a long-standing customer.

Usage data already sits with you: data volumes, roaming, device age, top-ups and contract end dates show who is about to leave or ready to upgrade. Today that signal lives in analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and anti churn campaigns are usually built by hand, per segment, per month. A customer who is about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all, and the signal arrives too late.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per subscriber from usage, top-ups, contract end dates and support contacts. The right offer, channel and moment, chosen for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next service when it fits
cases.text: Next best offer per customer, an added service or a faster plan, triggered by real usage. No more blanket upgrade mails to people already on the right package.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the service
cases.text: Personal usage nudges in app, SMS and email, such as a data bundle before the limit, so every customer has a reason to stay active each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
